QuestInfo.name: [Neo Tokyo] The Last Prayer
QuestInfo.0: You've destroyed the Nibelung warship. Between that and the loss of Bergamot, the enemy now has no clear commander on land or in the air. Leave the rest to humanity's ultimate weapon.
